# Expertens veckocase: Det köper och säljer Petersson

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a weekly segment in which guest expert Ulf Petersson reviews his running paper portfolio of long and short cases and gives one new buy case and one new sell case. He clears out several positions: he closes the Boliden short, drops Storskogen, Elekta and Ambea from the long side, keeps Latour long and keeps Nokia short. His new ideas are long Studsvik, on the nuclear power debate and the momentum from yesterday's news, and short Avanza, on insider selling and weak August trading. The mood is cautiously positive: rising interest rates are weighing on cyclical stocks, but the host notes that Ulf's past cases have mostly worked out.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SVIK — Studsvik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest Ulf's new long case: momentum after yesterday's news and a nuclear power debate that may pick up. Host Love agrees it can get hot but calls it expensive.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Ulf Petersson). Studsvik performed badly recently after a very weak Q2. Nuclear power news may renew investor interest, and it is the only listed nuclear exposure, so it could become a meme stock. The case is momentum-driven rather than based on valuation: Love says it is a dear stock. The weekly format implies a short horizon.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the nuclear power debate loses momentum
- if the valuation stretches further without earnings support
- if the next quarter is also weak

> *"Men nu tror jag kärnkraftsdebatten kan ta fart. med så vill nog folk in i Studsvik."*

---

### 🔴 AZA — Avanza | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest Ulf's new short case: an insider sale yesterday, fairly weak trading in August and a 12-14% rise in three months.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Insider selling, weaker trading activity in August and a strong recent run-up that has beaten the market suggest room for a pullback. Ulf says he himself found the short case harder to pick. Host Love points out that the stock has been very strong this year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if trading volumes rebound strongly
- if the market rally continues to lift brokers

> *"Jag tror att Avanza kommer bli billigare än vad den är idag."*

---

### 🔴 NOKIA — Nokia | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Short case kept after an 8.5% fall. Ulf still thinks the stock is too expensive.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. The short is kept on valuation grounds even after the drop.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation normalises
- if there is a positive news catalyst

> *"Den är fortfarande för dyr, det tycker jag."*

---

### 🟡 LATO-B — Latour | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Long case up over 8% and kept in the portfolio because it finally seems to be in a positive swing.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Momentum has turned positive after a long weak period, so Ulf keeps the long position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if momentum reverses

> *"Det känns som att de äntligen är inne i en positiv sving."*

---

### ⛔ STOR-B — Storskogen | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Removed from the long portfolio. Ulf likes the case but sees no trigger or momentum.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. The fundamental case is still liked, but without a catalyst or buyers the stock is dropped after a roughly 4% gain.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a catalyst or momentum emerges

> *"Det finns inget riktigt momentum i den så den skulle jag tacka för mig."*

---

### 🟠 EKTA-B — Elekta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Removed from the long portfolio. It could be one to own long term, but it did not react enough to its report.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. There is long-term potential, but the weak price reaction to the report means no near-term momentum.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the long-term case weakens

> *"Elekta kan också vara något att ha på lång sikt, men just nu så."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Buy candidate: rose on its report and is expensive, but the trend is very strong.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion, mentioned in passing as a momentum buy candidate despite the high valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the trend breaks

> *"Men den trenden är ju superstark så den tror jag kan fortsätta upp."*

---
